Vendored unmodified so the report works offline. Each is inlined into the
generated HTML with its licence header intact.

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `d3.v7.9.0.min.js` | [d3](https://github.com/d3/d3) | 7.9.0 | ISC |
| `elk.bundled.0.12.0.js` | [elkjs](https://github.com/kieler/elkjs) | 0.12.0 | EPL-2.0 |
| `fonts/space-grotesk-*.woff2` | [Space Grotesk](https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk) via @fontsource 5.3.0 | latin subset | OFL-1.1 |
| `fonts/ibm-plex-sans-*.woff2` | [IBM Plex](https://github.com/IBM/plex) via @fontsource 5.3.0 | latin subset | OFL-1.1 |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono-*.woff2` | [JetBrains Mono](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono) via @fontsource 5.3.0 | latin subset | OFL-1.1 |
